summary: NextCure, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) on June 1, 2026, to disclose a press release and corporate presentation regarding Phase 1 dose escalation data for its drug candidate SIM0505 at ASCO 2026. The filing reports clinical trial results—efficacy and safety data—for patients with advanced solid tumors. No transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. This is a routine clinical update. No deal terms apply. What to watch: future trial updates and potential regulatory milestones.
